business_problem: Órigo needed to centralize customer data, replace manual proposal and service processes, and connect sales and support channels so it could scale operations and stay close to customers.
solution_summary: Órigo built an integrated cloud service environment on Dynamics 365 to unify lead capture, customer service, marketing, and sales across its distributed solar and biogas business. Dynamics 365 Customer Service handles support demands, Dynamics 365 Omnichannel connects the contact surfaces, Dynamics 365 Marketing drives campaign and journey management, Dynamics 365 Sales distributes leads to commercial teams, and Power BI gives managers end-to-end visibility into team performance and customer progression. Chatbot interactions and data from other service platforms feed the same information base, which gives staff a 360-degree customer view instead of disconnected systems. The architecture lets Órigo manage service and revenue workflows in one coordinated model, from inbound lead to post-sale support. That shift removed manual proposal steps, accelerated response times from days to minutes, and gave leaders better control over a rapidly expanding customer operation.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Omnichannel
solution_components.role: Brings together service interactions from multiple customer channels.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Marketing
solution_components.role: Runs campaign, prospecting, and customer-journey workflows that feed the commercial pipeline.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
solution_components.role: Optimizes lead distribution and commercial follow-up from capture to conversion.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Gives managers and leaders integrated visibility into team activity and the sales process.

data_flow: Leads from marketing campaigns enter Dynamics 365, are distributed to commercial teams through the sales workflow, service and chatbot interactions are unified through Customer Service and Omnichannel, and Power BI reports the full journey through conversion and post-sales support.
business_outcome: Órigo reduced turnaround times from days to minutes, automated proposal generation, and gave managers a unified, data-driven view of customer and commercial operations.
